C218739: The trial will enrol adult participants aged 18 to 75 years with a confirmed diagnosis of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, defined as a Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) score of 12 or greater and a body surface area (BSA) involvement of 10% or greater at screening.
C25532: Participants must meet all three of the following inclusion criteria to be eligible for enrolment. First, participants must be aged 18 to 75 years at the time of signing the informed consent form. Second, participants must have a confirmed diagnosis of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis, defined as a Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) score of 12 or greater and a body surface area (BSA) involvement of 10% or greater at screening. Third, participants must have a body weight of at least 40 kg at screening.
C25370: Participants meeting any of the following exclusion criteria are not eligible for enrolment. Participants must not have received prior treatment with any biologic agent targeting IL-17, IL-23, or TNF-alpha within 24 weeks prior to randomisation. Participants with an active systemic infection or a history of recurrent serious infections are excluded. Participants who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the trial are not eligible.
C218740: Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) are defined as women who are biologically capable of becoming pregnant. Women who are postmenopausal (at least 12 consecutive months of spontaneous amenorrhoea) or permanently sterile are not considered WOCBP.
C218741: WOCBP must agree to use a highly effective method of contraception from the time of screening until at least 12 weeks after the last dose of investigational product. Male participants with female partners of childbearing potential must agree to use barrier contraception during the same period.
C218742: Participants must comply with the following lifestyle restrictions throughout their participation in the trial.
C218743: Participants must avoid grapefruit, grapefruit juice, and Seville oranges from 7 days prior to the first dose until the end of the treatment period.
C218744: Participants must abstain from alcohol consumption within 24 hours prior to and 24 hours following each study visit. Tobacco use should be stable throughout the trial period.
C218745: Participants should avoid strenuous physical activity within 48 hours prior to scheduled blood sampling visits.
C49628: Participants who fail to meet eligibility criteria at screening will be considered screen failures. Screen failure data will be collected to understand the characteristics of the screened population.
C179373: Rescreening may be permitted once, at the discretion of the investigator, if the screen failure was due to a transient condition that has resolved.
